headlines.shortLinkText: Hischier scores 2nd goal of game in OT to lift Devils past Kraken, 3-2

headlines.description: — Rasmus Dahlin scored a pair of power-play goals and the Buffalo Sabres won for the 14th time in their last 16 games, 5-2 over the Philadelphia Flyers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dahlin scores 2 power-play goals to lift Sabres to 5-2 win over Flyers

headlines.shortLinkText: Brady Tkachuk scores his 200th goal as the Senators beat the Rangers 8-4

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Mark Stone scored 25 seconds into overtime, Jack Eichel had three assists and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stone scores in OT, Eichel had 3 assists in Golden Knights' 3-2 win over Kings
